provenance_and_confirmatory_status.methodological_boundary: High-level G1–G5 hypotheses and general criteria were frozen in Phase 1 (configs/p12_b2_protocol.yaml, docs/p12_b2_frozen_protocol_draft.md). However, exact operational estimands, common-support equal-service trio criteria, and implementation code were finalized after Phase 5 execution outcomes were inspected. Therefore, exact Phase 6 calculations are retrospective/exploratory and cannot be designated as preregistered confirmatory analyses. This limitation cannot be repaired retroactively using the same data; confirmatory validation requires untouched future events or a separately frozen replication.

equal_service_contract.cost_and_carbon_rule: Cost and carbon comparisons are valid only when compared rows have equal completed service.
equal_service_contract.g3_core_deployable_trio_rule: Core deployable trio (static_unaware, capacity_aware, full_thermal_aware) must have exact equality of demanded and completed processing slots at the individual condition level before computing policy separation.
equal_service_contract.violation_action: Exclude unequal-service trios prior to computing policy separation. Mark contrasts UNEQUAL_SERVICE_EXCLUDED.

estimands_and_metrics.g1_tested_feasibility_boundary_algorithm: For static_unaware under power_capped/medium, a row is strictly feasible only if scheduler_feasible=True, thermally_feasible=True, unfinished_slots=0, jobs_missed=0, violation_hours=0, and max_exceedance_kw=0. Max tested multiplier across {1.0, 2.0, 3.0} is the seed boundary (0.0x if none feasible; NON_ESTIMABLE if cells missing/failed). Seed boundaries averaged per window; delta_boundary = hw_boundary - ctrl_boundary; aggregated to regional episodes.
estimands_and_metrics.g3_common_support_algorithm: Heatwave common-support set = valid equal-service (seed, multiplier) conditions in heatwave. Ordinary windows must possess valid equal-service trios for every heatwave condition (otherwise excluded). Separation calculated using identical conditions and weights across heatwave and ordinary windows. K = count of common-support-complete ordinary windows (K >= 10 gate). Strict inequality: heatwave separation > ordinary P95.

G1_temporal_replication.frozen_claim: Feasibility boundaries and policy-performance separations recur across multiple independent warm-season years.
G1_temporal_replication.narrow_claim: Static-policy power-cap vulnerability replicated across the available warm-season years.
G1_temporal_replication.classification_rule: Full G1 claim requires replication of feasibility boundaries and equal-service policy gaps across >= 2 years. Feasibility boundaries show null shifts across 5/6 episodes and -0.5x in 1 episode (mean delta = -0.08x). Equal-service policy gaps are heavily constrained by high-load throttling. Full G1 is therefore classified LIMITED; narrow static vulnerability claim is classified SUPPORTED.

G2_geographic_heterogeneity.claim: Thermal feasibility and policy separation magnitudes systematically vary across California climate regions.
G2_geographic_heterogeneity.confirmatory_criteria: >= 2 independent regional episodes per compared class AND cluster-bootstrap uncertainty interval excluding zero.
G2_geographic_heterogeneity.shared_carbon_proxy_rule: EIA CISO carbon proxy is shared across California; geographic carbon heterogeneity is unidentifiable.

G3_benchmark_discriminability.claim: Complete heatwave windows are more discriminating among policies than ordinary warm-season windows.
G3_benchmark_discriminability.procedure: Common workload support equal-service comparison against frozen ordinary P95 (K >= 10).

G4_full_event_continuity_gate.claim: Multi-day full-event evaluation captures compounding thermal and backlog dynamics missed by isolated peak-day windows.
G4_full_event_continuity_gate.gate_requirement: Strict proof that full-event vs 120-hour peak ablation preserves equivalent causal histories, workload arrivals, deadlines, completed service, and cross-boundary allocation states.
G4_full_event_continuity_gate.failure_action: Mark NON_ESTIMABLE without new scheduler execution.

G5_bounded_robustness.claim: Primary findings are stable across variations in event definition threshold, duration, thermal parameters, capacity limits, and episode grouping.
G5_bounded_robustness.comparator_inventory: energy_only_facility is a baseline comparator, not a G5 sensitivity variant.
G5_bounded_robustness.robustness_criteria: Finding is robust only if sign and substantive interpretation persist across all valid variants. Unexecuted variants are NON_ESTIMABLE and do not support robustness.
